verdict.rationale: Phoenix's own tracing docs promise a detailed breakdown of token usage for LLM calls, which covers per-request token visibility. Nothing in the evidence shows cost tracking, aggregation by model or time period, or dashboard views. missing for 10: cost (dollar) tracking, per-model aggregation, time-period trend dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Gain a detailed breakdown of token usage for your LLM calls, allowing you to identify and optimize the most expensive LLM invocations.
